verdict.rationale: Context.dev is a hosted web-extraction API, so letting users choose their own LLM backend is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence pack documents only cloud-side JSON Schema extraction (docs-4, docs-21), with no mention of configuring a local or self-hosted model. With no evidence for an applicable capability, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a developer, I can plug in a local or self-hosted LLM as the extraction backend instead of a cloud-only model
